lines.text: Tickle, tickle in your nose! Your eyes squeeze shut, you take a sharp breath, and...
ACHOOO! A giant explosive sneeze blasts out into your elbow tissue!
Did you know a sneeze can launch droplets at up to one hundred miles per hour?
Your nose is lined with millions of microscopic cilia hairs acting as security guards!
When dust, pollen, or pepper touches the trigeminal nerve inside your nasal lining...
A red alert flashes to the sneeze center in your lower brainstem!
Your chest muscles tighten, vocal cords snap shut, and air pressure builds like a cannon!
POW! It ejects unwanted germs and dust so your airways stay clean and safe!
Celebrate your body's built-in defenses—subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
